violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the pizza kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Soap was provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Raw chicken was observed held above the little neck clams and salmon filet in the grill cooler drawer. Food items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment is to add a notifying symbol to the menu signifying which items are available raw or undercooked to their request. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils are not stored inverted. Equipment and utensils were inverted during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on prep unit #1, #2, and the grill cooler drawers. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The floor tile grout in the ware washing area of the main kitchen was observed to be worn and low and is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back hallway, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2025

The cutting boards in the kitchens are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2025

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the cookline prep units and cold drawer by pizza oven. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/16/2024

The door to the outside, located in the receiving area , is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2024

The cutting boards of the prep units are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2024
